༄༅/ /gshin rje sogs lhag pa'i lha 'ga' zhig bsnyen pa'i tshe dngos nyams rmi lam byung ba'i rim pa kha shas bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// gshin rje sogs lhag pa'i lha 'ga' zhig bsnyen pa'i tshe dngos nyams rmi lam byung ba'i rim pa kha shas bzhugs so//

sa mo yos lo hor zla bcu gnyis pa'i yar tshes brgyad nas bzung*/ gshin rje tshe bdag gi las sbyor gyi sgrub pa zhig bgyis pa'i tshes brgyad kyi rmi lam du khang pa khang rnying zhig gi nang du/ mkha' 'gro'i bsus zlog byed khul du 'dug pa'i bsus ma'i tshig rnams/ drung pa lhang ling ma yin rgyu bas 'khrab cing*/ bdag gi gos 'gab nas 'jus te 'gro dgos tshul zer 'dug par/ de'i lan 'debs bshol ma byed mi bla ma mchod gnas ga mdog ma yin rtsis zhig gzi brjid shin tu che ba khang pa'i gung na byams bzhugs byas nas skad gdangs mthon pos 'then gyi 'dug pa'i bar du/ bud med gzhon nu ma rigs lnga sogs rgyan chas sngar mthong ma myong bas spras pa mang po sa la bsdad nas ḍā dril dang bcas snyan pa'i gdangs mang po byed kyi 'dug pas ci yin snyam pas/ 'khor lo rin chen bkra shis don gyi lha// bkra shis des kyang deng 'dir bde legs stsol// zhes 'then gyi 'dug /yar bltas pas khang pa'i gung na rje btsun 'jam dbyangs kyi sku thang zhig bshams 'dug pa'i zhal nas| mche ba gtsigs shing sgrim pa yi// 'jigs pa'i tshul gyi sku yi ni// gshin rje dregs pa 'joms mdzad pa// sogs zla gsang gi rgyud nas gsungs pa'i bstod pa de gsung gi 'dug pa'i mus la gnyid sad pa zhig byung*/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nub sa ngo mi shes pa zhig tu phyin pa na sa 'og nas 'od dmar po shin tu 'tsher ba zhig stong gsum khengs pa'i 'phror nyi ma dmar po zhig thon byung ba dang*/ de dang bstun par nam mkha' nas 'od dkar po phyogs bcur 'phro ba'i zla ba zhig bab byung ba phyogs gcig tu/ bdag gi lus kyi steng 'og tu thim pas cung zad dran med du song ba sad ma thag /bde stong gi nyams tshad med shar ba zhig byung ba'i 'phror gnyid sad byung ba ni rlung rtsol dang 'khrul 'khor sogs ma byas kyang*/ yi dam gyi thugs rjes khams dkar dmar dbu ma'i snying gar 'phrad cing 'dres par go// tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs kyi thun btang nas/

rgyab tu cung zad bsnyes te sngags bzlas pa'i 'phro/ lcang lo can gyi gnam yangs kyi nam mkhar 'od lnga 'khrugs shing*/ de dag gi dbus me yi tsha tsha 'khrugs pa'i klong du 'jam dpal gshin rje tshe bdag yab yum sras sprul gyi sku rnams gsal 'tsher 'od du 'bar zhing*/ dgyes pa'i gar nyams dang gad mos stong gsum khengs pa ltar mdzad pa zhig yun ring du mthong bas tshad med pa'i dad pa brtan pos bstod pa dang smon lam du bgyis pa'i mod la/ 'ja' tshon ltar rang bzhin med par song ba'i mur nam langs kyi ngag 'don la 'jug ran par 'dug |nyer lnga'i nam gung gi thun skabs 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi sku shin tu khro zhing mi sdug pa zhig yud tsam mjal bas/ de'i nyin zhag la snying 'dar zhing 'jigs snang shin tu che ba rang byung ba'i phyi nub rmi lam du rang gi lte ba'i khung nas sngar dam nyams pa'i slob ma 'ga' zhig ham skya thal mdog lus shin tu chung bar byas nas thon song ba zhig rmis pas dam sri'i bar chad zhig 'dug pa yi dam gyis brtul ba e yin bsam pa byung*/ nyer bdun gyi srod thun btang nas gnyid la song ba skad cig la 'jigs snang gis bskul te har sad byas byung ba yar bltas pas/ mdun gyi gnam yangs nang du me 'od kyi klong nas 'jam dpal gshin rje zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa ma he dang chu glang la zhabs bsgyings pa zhig gi zhal nas/ e ā ra li pheṃ pheṃ phaṭ phaṭ/ ces sgrog pa thos dar cig sems ma yeng bar gnas ma thag slar gnyid la thum phrad du song ba zhig byung bar/ de snga yin phan chad mig btsum pa'i mig lam du yi dam gang gsal btab pa mthong ba zhig yod pa de/ de nas bzung da lta'i bar du mig btsums nas yi dam gang yid la byas pa de/ de ma thag tu zhal phyag gsal bar mthong zhing*/ de'i mu la yi dam gzhan zhig yid la byas na snga ma de phyi ma yid la gang byas de'i skur 'gyur 'gro ba zhig da lta'i bar du byung ngo*// gzhan yang las sbyor gyi rtags 'ga' yar mthong ba 'dir ma bris so| /de ltar gshin rje tshe bdag gi sgrub pa dgu la grol nas/

lo de ka'i sos gtor hor zla gnyis pa rang la byed rtsis yin yang*/ rgyal sgo bar du a bo don grub rgyal po 'brum nad kyis 'das pa'i rkyen gyis mi nyi shu tsam tshe las 'das pa zhig byung*/ de tsam las 'phros pa'i ha cang skyon nad che ba mi yong bar shes kyang*/ phyi nang thams cad kyi sgro skur rnam rtog kha yan du btang ba'i lab brjod mang ba zhig gis sems shin tu 'khrugs pa zhig byung bas/ nad de la dmigs pa'i drang srong loka tri pā la'i 'byung bzhi'i las sbyor tshang ba'i sgrub pa zhig zla ba de ka'i tshes bcu gcig nas dbu btsugs pa'i tshe/ tshes bcu gsum gyi nub rmi lam du sngar gtsang gi gnas rnying rgyal po rang gi gcen por brdzus te byung ba loka tri'i dbang bskur zhig bgyis pa de nyid de nub kyang mi dkar rta dkar can zhig tu brdzus te byung ba shes kyang*/ khyod su yin dris pas gtsang nas 'ongs gnas rnying rgyal po yin zer/ ci la 'ong dris pas sngar loka tri'i dbang zhus pa de shin tu 'phrod pa byung bas do nub kyang de 'dra ba zhig gyis zer/ de ltar byas pas 'gro khar/ da dung yang skabs bab zhig la loka tri'i dbang zhig zhu bar log yong bas de dus skad cha gsar pa yang khyer yong zer/ de nub dbang yon la mi'i mgo zhig dang*/ lcags kyi tho ba zhig bzhag nas log song bar rmis/ tshes bco lnga'i tho rangs kyi thun btang nas sngags bzla ba'i tshe lcang lo can gyi gnam yangs nang du 'od dkar po kha ba lta bu'i dbus su/ drang srong dri med shin tu gsal ba zhig mjal bas mchod bstod smon lam bgyis pa'i tshe/ drang srong gi zhal nas da lam 'brum pa 'di la 'jigs pa mi 'byung zhing myur du 'chad par 'gyur/ gzhan yang rims nad 'ga' zhig 'dug pa yang de dang mnyam du nges par 'chad pas bag 'khums par mi dgos/ de tsam ma zad khyod rang gi lus rten la 'brum nad kyi 'tshe ba da phyin kyang mi 'byung ngo zhes gsung ba'i dbugs dbyung dang*/

gzhan yang gsung gleng mang du byung ba'i 'phros khyod sngon dharma a sho kar gyur pa'i dus su sa gdon gyi nyen pa kho bos grol bar byas pa yin gyi/ de phyin skye ba 'ga' yar yang kho bos rjes su bzung zhing da dung yang rjes su 'dzin par 'gyur ro// khyod kyi skye ba phyi ma bdun tsam la sa gdon gyi gnod pa 'byung zhing*/ de mi 'byung bar 'dod na/ rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa la bsnyen cig |ces gsungs nas mi snang bar gyur to// tshes bcu drug nas bco brgyad bar du rgyal 'gong kho na rmis shing de dag kyang drang srong dmod pas tshar gcod pa 'ba' zhig byung yang*/ sngar rab sgang gser phye thang du/ yang ri sgar pa la 'brum nad kyi 'tshe ba byung dus 'jam dpal gshin rje'i sgrub pa zhig bgyis skabs 'brum pa'i nad bdag mgo zhal mo dngos su byung nas dam la btags/ khas blangs byas pa yin yang ma byung bas ji ltar yin snyam/ 'on kyang 'brum nad sogs rims nad kyi rigs 'ga' zung 'di skabs byung ba nyes med kyis chad pa'i mtshan ma mthong bas tshes bcu dgu la las sbyor rnams grub par byas nas nang mtshams lhod tsam byas/ slar zla ba de ka'i nyer drug nas bzung*/ drang srong dri med kyi gsung gi snang ba la brten nas rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa'i bsnyen sgrub shin tu dam pa zhig bgyis pa'i nyer dgu snga ma'i nub rmi lam du lung pa ngo mi shes pa zhig nas bdag ngos su sprin dang na bun 'khrigs pa'i khrod nas kha char shin tu che ba bab byung bar/ bdag gis sngags btab pas lce steng nas sbrul nag po shin tu che ba zhig thon song bas/ kha char sprin dang na bun thams cad zos song ba zhig rmis/ nyer dgu phyi ma'i nub bdag grogs mched 'ga' zung gi sku gsung thugs rten kha shas la/ dpal 'khor lo sdom pa'i ras bris kyi dkyil 'khor la brten nas/ rab gnas kyi dngos gzhi khrus gsol la 'grim par chas pa'i tshe/

ras bris kyi gtso bo 'khor lo sdom pas/ de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang de sras la// zhes khrus gsol gyi tshig bskul byung ba sogs rmis/ gnam stong gi nyin nas 'bru bzhi la grangs tshad thems nas bcu bzhi pa bzla ba'i tshe nyin gung gi thun grub nas bzung*/ dgong thun ma grub bar phreng thag sbrul kho nar 'dug pas/ 'di 'khrul ba yin phreng zhags sbrul yong don med bsams kyang*/ sbrul rang du 'dug pas cung zad yid snang the tshom yang byung*/ de nas rmi lam du sngar rab sgang du dam bcas khas blangs bgyis pa'i 'brum pa'i nad bdag go zhal mo slebs byung bas/ khyod ga nas 'ong dris pas/ gtsang phyogs nas dbus chu gzhung rgyud nas yongs zer/ da lam 'brum bu 'di kho mos btang ba min yang khyod kyis de ltar mi shes shing khros nas gsod kyis dogs ma 'ong zer/ 'o na da lam gyi 'brum pa'i nad bdag su yin dris pas/ da res 'brum pa rgyal 'gong drug bdun tsam 'dus nas btang zer/ de nas gang du song*/ rgyu rkyen gang gis lan dris pas/ de rnams la la drang srong gi dmod pas de ma thag shi/ lhag ma rnams dbus phyogs su song*/ da lam nad 'di 'phan yul mang zhing du a bo a rgyal 'chi khar jo lags jo lags zer gyin sems chags nas shi bas lan zer/ 'o na a bo a rgyal 'dre la skyes pa yin nam dris pas kho 'dre la ma skyes kyang rgyu rkyen de las byung zer/ de ci yin dris pas 'chad du ma 'dod// bdag 'dir skor tsam ma 'ong na khyod kyis bdag ma byung bsam pa dang 'brum pa yang bdag gis btang bas sngon gyi khas len nyams sam snyam pa'i khu 'phrig byung gi dogs 'ongs zer/ gang du 'gro dris pas gar 'gro nges pa med/ 'on kyang dbus gtsang gang rung 'gro zer bud song ba zhig rmis/ gnam gang gi srod tsam nas lus la shu thor dang sha ro 'gul 'phrig sogs byung zhing*/ tshes gcig gi nyin de rnams cher byung bas phyag rgya thebs pa'i rtags su mthong yang de nyin sogs bsnyen pa 'phro ma bshol bar bzlas pas/

tshes gcig gi srod thun grub tsam la/ mdun du rig pa'i rgyal po nā ga rak+ṣa dbu dgu phyag bcu drug sbrul mjug dang bcas pa pad lugs ku sā li rkyang sgrub zhig gsal bar mjal bas sems can thams cad la sa gdon gyi gnod pa spyir mi 'byung ba dang khyad par bdag rang gi bsrung 'khor du gang bcug pa la sa gdon gyi gnod pa mi 'byung ba'i smon lam yang btab/ de nas gnyid du song ba'i nam gung tsam rmi lam du mi sngon po zhig byung ba gang nas 'ong dris pas/ mal gro nas 'ongs zer/ klu gzi chen yin nam dris pas/ de kha yin zer/ ci la yong dris pas/ mal gro'i klu'i kha gnon nyams pa gso phyir ka tshal sngags khang du gser gdung mdun gyi kho bo'i 'dra 'bag yod pas/ khang pa der sngon chad sha chang mi khyer ba zhig yin yang dus phyis sha chang khyer bas kho bo khams ma bde bas/ des dgon pa la yang gnod cing*/ bdag la yang gnod pas sha chang ma khyer zhes ngag bsgo zhing nga'i 'dra 'bag la klu sman dang rin po che dang dar zab gyis gsar du mchod na kun la shis so zer nas bud song bas/ gnyid sad pa na des sems khrid nas 'khrul pa'i snang bar/ sngon slob dpon pad+ma bsam yas mchims phur bzhugs skabs rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan klu gzi chen dang grogs mched byas te/ klu'i lus bstan pas sa nad kyis zin nas/ slob dpon chen po la gsol ba btab pa'i tshe/ slob dpon gyis sngon 'das pa'i dus rgya gar gyi yul bhaṅga la bam dra zhes bya bar rgyal po rat+na dha ra gtsug gi nor bu zhes bya ba'i sras/ rgyal bu mtha' yas 'od bya ba lo bcu gnyis lon pa'i tshe sa nad kyis rkang pa gnyis gum ste mal du gnas pa na/ yab rgyal por mchod gnas dge slong tshul khrims dang ldan pa zhig yod pa de la/ dge slong khyod kyis bdag gi bu sa nad las grol bar gyis shig ces bsgo ba'i tshe/ dge slong gis lha la gsol ba btab pas rmi lam du lhas ri bo mgrin bzang zhes bya ba'i rtse mor sangs rgyas 'od srung gis rab gnas byas pa'i mchod rten yod pas de'i bum pa'i nang du/

klu'i rgyud 'bum gyi ṭā'i ka bzhugs pa'i nang nas klu'i srung ba nā ga rak+ṣa zhes bya ba bzhugs pa blangs la nyams su longs shig ces lung bstan pa rmis pas/ dge slong gis de ltar byas pas/ rgyal bu snyung nad las grol ba yin no// de'i tshe de'i dus kyi yab rgyal po rat+na gtsug gi nor bu ni mnga' bdag rgyal po khri srong lde'u btsan yin no// rgyal bu mtha' yas 'od ni lha sras mu tig btsad po yin no| |dge slong de ni nga yin no// zhes sogs nā ga rak+ṣa'i lo rgyus rgyas par gsungs pa 'khrul snang du gsal bar dran pa zhig byung*/ de'i thor thun gyi skabs/ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das mtshams shed na// zhes bstod pa 'don pa'i skabs/ mdun du rig pa'i rgyal po dbu dgu phyag nyis brgya sbrul mjug can gnubs lugs tshom bu tshogs sgrub zhig yun ring du mjal bas lus sems bde bar gyur/ phyi nangs nam langs pa dang mdang gi lo rgyus dran pa de sngar ma thos pa'i the tshom du gyur nas nā raka gyi chos skor rnams bltas pas/ lo rgyus rgyas pa zhig la de kho na ltar 'dug pas yid ches shing*/ lha dang bla ma la dad pa thob par gyur/ de nas tshes gnyis gsum rnams la gzhan pa'i phan 'dod kyi bsam pas seng ldeng phur bu sgrub pa dang*/ klu srung gi rab gnas sogs rung bar bgyis pa'i tshe/ seng ldeng gi phur bu rnams la me 'bar ba sogs drod rtags tshad rdzogs pa sogs byung bas khad kyi mtshams grol ba sogs byas la/ da lta yang lus la phyag rgya thebs pa'i rtags rnams ches gsal bar 'dug go// kho bo nyams chung chos kyi grags pa la// gnas dus dbang gis phyi nang dgra gnyen gyis// mi brtsi lta zhog khyi tsam mthong med cing*// sna tshogs sgro skur zhabs tog mang na yang*// bla ma lha dang mkha' 'gro chos srung gis// zhal bstan gsung thos yang nas yang yang du// rjes su bzung nas mjal kyang blo bde'i dpal// mi kun ji ltar dgyes dgyes gsung sgros mdzod// yin min bden rdzun 'byed pa'i gsong po ni// deng sang sa steng dpang por zhal bzhes rnams// dngos nor rjes su sprang khyis zan mthong bzhin// rgyal khrims btsongs nas dkor mdzod nor gyis 'gengs// de 'dra'i legs nyes zhal lce ji ltar gcod// de bas gsong po gzur gnas stangs 'dzin mkhan// gshin rje chos kyi rgyal po drang ngo zer// gtam de thos pas tshul dang tshul min la// blang dor byas shing gsung rab dpang du bzhag

/rgyu dang 'bras bu'i chos la yid ches pas// 'di phyir mi 'gyod gdeng thob dga' spro 'phel// de ltar 'khrul snang nyams dngos rmi lam la// kun gyi cal sgrog the tshom sgro skur gyi// gzhi yin phyir na kun la mi sgrog cing*// yi ger mi 'bri gsang zhing sba bsams kyang*// dad ldan 'ga' yi nan gyis bskul ba'i ngor// rtsa ba'i ltung ba bcu gnyis pa de nyid// byung dogs 'jigs pas mdor bsdus rags pa tsam// mgyogs par bris te lha mo'i phyag tu phul// //maṅga laṃ//
